# spoo.me

> Open-source link management platform with advanced analytics and an API-first core. Self-hostable in one command. Free short links, QR codes, password protection, expiry, and click analytics.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://spoo.me): shorten links, no account required
- [About](https://spoo.me/about): what spoo.me is and how it is run
- [Apps & SDKs](https://spoo.me/apps): official clients for Raycast, Chrome, Discord, Telegram, Slack, Windows, Android, iOS, plus SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, Kotlin, and C++
- [Link stats lookup](https://spoo.me/stats): public click analytics for any spoo.me short link

## Tools

- [Free link tools](https://spoo.me/tools): UTM builder and other small link utilities, no account needed
- [UTM builder](https://spoo.me/tools/utm-builder): build tagged campaign links, shorten them, and track clicks

## Developers

- [Documentation](https://spoo.me/docs/introduction): API reference, self-hosting guides, SDK quickstarts
- [Docs index for LLMs](https://spoo.me/docs/llms.txt)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/spoo-me): AGPL-licensed source for the platform and every client

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://spoo.me/privacy)
- [Terms](https://spoo.me/terms)
- [Report abuse](https://spoo.me/report)
